description: C-54 built 1944 as USAAF 42-72302 (c/n 10407), N88929, then Avianca C-136/HK-136 - the aircraft in which Capt. Jaime Duque opened Avianca's international routes; later Aerotal. Displayed in the park as the 'Avión HK136' attraction in Avianca colours; photographed August 2024.

FAC flagship Stearman (c/n 75-4881, built 1942), restored and flown by CATAM in 1972 and kept airworthy at EMAVI for decades; the museum's June 2025 page and the park's attraction list place it inside the Taj Mahal hall. Photographed at the park August 2024.
